events.title: 16 Days of Activism against Gender-Based Violence
events.organiser: UN Women, Ministry of Women and Children Affairs, UN in Bangladesh and NGOs
events.summary: This year's global theme is "Ensure justice, protect survivors, end impunity". In Bangladesh the campaign runs alongside new figures showing that only 7.4% of women who face partner violence take legal action. Devlens is covering it every day until 10 December.

events.title: International Women Human Rights Defenders Day
events.organiser: Marked by UN Women and rights groups during the 16 Days campaign
events.summary: A day to recognise women who defend human rights, often at personal risk. It falls in the middle of the 16 Days campaign.

events.title: World AIDS Day
events.organiser: UNAIDS and WHO; marked in Bangladesh by the health ministry and NGOs
events.summary: A day to review progress on HIV testing, treatment and prevention.

events.title: International Day of Persons with Disabilities
events.organiser: United Nations; marked by disability rights organisations in Bangladesh
events.summary: Falls during the 16 Days campaign. Women and girls with disabilities face a higher risk of violence and more barriers to reporting it and getting help.

events.title: International Volunteer Day
events.organiser: UN Volunteers
events.summary: Recognises the volunteers who support disaster response, health outreach and community work across Bangladesh.

events.title: APASL Single Topic Conference Dhaka 2026 on fatty liver disease
events.organiser: Asian Pacific Association for the Study of the Liver and Hepatology Society, Dhaka
events.summary: A regional medical conference on metabolic dysfunction-associated fatty liver disease (MAFLD), a growing non-communicable disease concern in Bangladesh.

events.title: Begum Rokeya Day and Rokeya Padak
events.organiser: Ministry of Women and Children Affairs
events.summary: Marks the birth and death anniversary of Begum Rokeya Sakhawat Hossain, a pioneer of women's education. The government presents the Rokeya Padak to women for their contribution to women's rights and education.
events.source: Ministry of Women and Children Affairs

events.title: Human Rights Day and close of the 16 Days campaign
events.organiser: United Nations
events.summary: Marks the adoption of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights. The 16 Days campaign ends on this day; Devlens will publish a wrap-up.

events.title: Universal Health Coverage Day
events.organiser: UHC2030 and WHO
events.summary: A day to push for health care that people can use without falling into poverty. In Bangladesh, people still pay most health costs out of their own pockets.

events.title: International Migrants Day
events.organiser: United Nations; marked in Bangladesh by the Ministry of Expatriates' Welfare, BMET and migrant rights groups
events.summary: Bangladesh observes the day with events across the country on safe migration, recruitment costs and the rights of migrant workers and their families.

events.title: DU Economics International Conference 2027
events.organiser: Department of Economics and Bureau of Economic Research, University of Dhaka
events.summary: Theme: "Development at a Crossroads: Rethinking Growth, Equity and Economic Governance". Full papers are due on 26 December 2026.

events.title: National dialogue on violence against women and access to justice
events.organiser: Manusher Jonno Foundation
events.summary: Speakers said very few women who face violence go to court, citing the BBS and UNFPA survey finding that only 7.4% take legal action.

events.title: RTI Forum meets the new Information Commission
events.organiser: Right to Information Forum
events.summary: The forum called for a more independent, better staffed and better funded Information Commission.

events.title: COP31 ends without a main agreement
events.organiser: UNFCCC
events.summary: The talks ran nearly 50 hours over time and closed on 22 November with no main cover decision. The proposed $120 billion adaptation finance target for 2035 was dropped from every final text, a setback for Bangladesh, which had pushed for adaptation money as grants rather than loans.

events.title: Rohingya crisis at year ten and beyond: rethinking the response
events.organiser: BRAC
events.summary: The Prime Minister's adviser on finance and planning called short-term aid "the most expensive way to manage a long crisis" and urged multi-year funding.

events.title: World court rules in The Gambia v. Myanmar genocide case
events.organiser: International Court of Justice
events.summary: The judgment has major implications for accountability and for the Rohingya refugee response in Bangladesh.

events.title: International conference on land governance and food sovereignty
events.organiser: ALRD and ANGOC
events.summary: Civil society delegates from six countries made 33 demands on land rights for marginalised communities and women farmers.

events.title: Bangladesh's first international debt conference
events.organiser: Finance Division and Asian Development Bank
events.summary: Held as interest payments take a growing share of the budget, leaving less room for social spending.

events.title: CLIK Hub scoping workshop at RUET
events.organiser: RUET Department of Urban and Regional Planning and GIZ Bangladesh
events.summary: Scoped regional climate innovation and research for northern Bangladesh.

events.title: 5th Bangladesh Economic Summit 2026
events.organiser: Bonik Barta
events.summary: Discussed macroeconomic stability, energy and LDC graduation strategy.

events.title: Impact Investment Day 2026
events.organiser: National Advisory Board for Impact Investment (NAB) Bangladesh
events.summary: A two-day conference on putting bank deposits, pension and insurance funds and remittances to work for social and environmental goals. Relevant to NGOs and social enterprises looking for blended finance.

events.title: First International Day for the Elimination of Child, Early and Forced Marriage
events.organiser: United Nations
events.summary: The UN General Assembly named 27 November as the day in September 2026. UNFPA said Bangladesh must act twentyfold faster to end child marriage by 2030.
